# Bid the scrape, the skim, and the extras.

> Price popcorn ceiling removal from ceiling area, scrape-and-prime versus Level 4 skim versus Level 5 plus paint, 8-foot versus vaulted versus two-story access, and extras — plus the walk-away price a $1.50 / sq ft special cannot see.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.
